# Graphics

Kind: context · Defined in [`src/logic/settings/graphics.h`](../../../src/logic/settings/graphics.h) · Scene / prefab name: `null` · Described in `data/core.json`

The levels of resources/graphics.json, from the cheapest, and the applied one

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `presets` | `std::vector<GraphicsPreset>` | the levels (name, view_distance, ray_tracing, lighting[2], probe rays, far plants, textures, relief, grass layers / shadow / see-through, lod_bias, normal maps, subsurface, streaming) |
| `current` | `int` | index of the applied level, -1: the defaults of the code |

## Notes

Emplaced by Game; the Renderer applies it, the debug menu switches it.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: Renderer. Written by: DebugMenu, Game. Created by: Game. Destroyed by: —.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [DebugMenu](../systems/DebugMenu.md) | system | Host | **readwrite** | tick | the Graphics combo: current preset, applied to RenderSettings and Settings::view_distance |
| [Game](../systems/service-Game.md) | service | Host | **write+create** | Game::Game | levels of resources/graphics.json and the current one |
| [Renderer](../systems/service-Renderer.md) | service | Host | **read** | constructor | current and presets: the level of resources/graphics.json to apply. |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[DebugMenu](../systems/DebugMenu.md)**
  - One ImGui window "Dynamical" (needs UI before it).
  - Changing the soil or grass height-map parameters makes SoilMaps / GrassPass bake their per-chunk maps again (they watch RenderSettings).
  - Creates torch entities and dynamic boxes (Jolt bodies through RigidBodySys) on button presses; destroys every PointLight entity on "No torches".
- **[Game](../systems/service-Game.md)**
  - Reads and writes ./config.7.json; reads resources/graphics.json and the scene files.
  - Creates the Renderer (Vulkan, SDL window, OpenXR).
  - Creates the host thread pool (tf::Executor).
  - Logs unknown arguments, ignored values, the graphics level and scene errors.
- **[Renderer](../systems/service-Renderer.md)**
  - Creates the window, OpenXR session, Vulkan device and swapchain through Context.
  - Makes Lights, RayScene, ProbeVolume, PlantVolumes (with ray tracing), TreeShade, SoilMaps, ClassicRender, VRRender and the passes (SkyPass first, then the scene's renderer.passes).
  - GPU: per-frame fences and semaphores; one transfer, one compute and one graphics submission a frame; waits on the frame fence in prepare and on device idle in init and finish.
  - Threads: records both targets concurrently on the taskflow executor.
  - Log: 'Renderer : unknown pass <name>' (error).
  - Profiler zones: create lighting and targets, create pass / pipelines <name>, update <pass>, Update, Record, Submit.
